decisions.reason: The live unscoped claim is labeled as the repair kit, but the article requires a complete kit with water pump and warns that LS and GSR belt/pump combinations differ; TB184K1 explicitly excludes the water pump and catalog applications prove only LS/RS/GS/Special Edition, not a safe all-engine claim.

Bosch 9619 fits and is the right product type, but the article prescribes plugs only when they are oil-fouled; the existing unconditional card has no diagnosis gate and therefore becomes a blanket sale.

The Continental kit fits and includes pump/seals, but the article mandates OEM Honda or Aisin for the tensioner and describes a complete job including hydraulic tensioner, idler, and accessory belts; the catalog does not establish those contents for PP211LK2.
